title: Elegant Spanish Falafel Crema Catalana
description: A unique twist on traditional Crema Catalana, this dish features crispy falafel and a rich nimono simmer, all in a creamy and fermented package, perfect for a special brunch occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the falafel according to the package instructions and set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the nimono broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the broth simmer for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the cream, eggs, salt, and paprika.
Add the cooked falafel to the cream mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the cream and falafel mixture into 4 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
